# Expected PR-CI failures: `npm run test:sim:fast` (tools/soak.ts subset).
#
# What this is: the exact failure lines the fast pinned-sim subset
# currently produces on main, extracted with `grep -E '^  FAIL '` and
# sorted (LC_ALL=C). The subset runs only the determinism, brain (incl.
# the hunter 1v1-regression tally), and pinned-codes sections of
# tools/soak.ts (SOAK_SECTIONS=determinism,brain,pinned-codes); every
# other section, incl. the full pairwise sweep and the manifests /
# featured-codes re-sims, stays Nightly-only (see
# .github/nightly-expected-soak.txt). The `N CHECK(S) FAILED` summary
# line is deliberately not included: the per-check lines already encode
# the count, and its format differs. These lines contain no durations,
# absolute paths, or memory figures, so no further stripping is needed;
# stable figures (win counts) are kept verbatim so a changed figure is
# a visible diff. Lines are kept verbatim, including the two leading
# spaces soak.ts prints. Comment lines starting with '#' are not
# extracted by the comparator.
#
# Green CI = baseline unchanged: `test:sim:fast` extracts the same
# lines from the subset run, sorts them the same way, and diffs them
# against the non-comment lines below. Exact match is green. Any
# difference is red: a new failure, a disappeared failure (a fix!),
# or a changed figure all show as a diff. Determinism contributes no
# lines today; a new determinism FAIL line is the gate working and
# must go red until it is explained and baselined here.
#
# Intentional baseline changes update this file in the same PR as the
# change that causes them. Do not edit this file to silence a diff you
# have not explained in that PR. This file does not fix or re-pin
# anything; whether to re-baseline the underlying checks is a separate
# decision.
  FAIL RA1 pinned code re-sims exactly
  FAIL RA2 pinned code re-sims exactly
  FAIL no 1v1 regression vs pre-brain hunter -- brawler (2<4)
